Our Teaching Approach Across Each Curriculum

Lessons follow how each curriculum assesses students, not a copy-paste method applied across every board.

IGCSE · GCSE · A-Level

British Curriculum

  • Past papers from session one. Students learn the marking criteria each British exam board uses, from Cambridge IGCSE 0580 to Edexcel A-Level Mathematics.

  • Timed written practice built in early. Accuracy of working becomes habit well before the exam hall.

  • Foundations rebuilt where they weakened, topic by topic, before any advanced work begins.

Curriculum Support Across the UAE

Ustaad provides British curriculum tutoring, American curriculum tutoring, and IB tutoring across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, and the wider UAE. Our tutors support students from leading UAE schools including Cranleigh, Brighton College, Repton, GEMS Wellington, Raha International, GEMS American Academy, Dubai International Academy, Yasmina British Academy, The British School Al Khubairat, GEMS Cambridge International, Yasmina American School, ACS Abu Dhabi, ATHS, ATS, and STS.
